facts.fact: The World Bank report, as reported by TechCabal, says NIMC had issued NINs to 117.5 million people out of 134.6 million enrolments at 30 June 2026.

TechCabal reports that enrolment captures demographic and biometric data and that issuance follows processing, validation and deduplication against the national database, as explained by two commentators.
The World Bank's August 2026 assessment says the NIMS 2.0 system integrator contract, built around MOSIP, was being finalised, with implementation expected to take about 18 months.
